primary.contrast: rlfa_past_certified scored hull width minus seq_detector_100 scored width on the identical observations and forecasts
report: pointwise approximate 95 percent Student t interval
simultaneous finite empirical Bernstein interval for the six contrasts
primary.finite_interval: For each of six independent-replicate sequences D in [-C,C], C=20000, use sample variance s2 with denominator n-1 and radius sqrt(2*s2*log(2/delta)/n) + 7*(2*C)*log(2/delta)/(3*(n-1)), delta=0.05/6; intersect with [-C,C]. No finite-sample superiority claim when this interval includes zero.
primary.practical_interpretation: Report magnitude; no new outcome-dependent minimum-gain threshold. The historical joint ten-percent target remains failed.

coverage.primary_new_interval_family: 3 strong interval constructions x 13 cells (10 synthetic mechanisms, 3 fixed COCO frames) x 3 budgets = 117 one-sided tests
coverage.endpoint: accepted_set_covers; for running sets this is the true total retained at every prefix through the budget
coverage.test: Exact binomial CDF P_{p=0.95}(X<=observed successes), Holm familywise alpha=0.05 over all 117 cells
coverage.interval: Pointwise two-sided 95 percent Clopper-Pearson interval, explicitly not simultaneous
coverage.other_endpoints: Hull coverage and all 16 retained interval constructions are reported with pointwise Clopper-Pearson intervals as secondary descriptive diagnostics; original published-family tests remain historical results.
coverage.interpretation: Failure to reject undercoverage does not prove nominal coverage. Mathematical guarantees remain conditional on their measurement, support and predictability assumptions.

secondary.external_scope: Three fixed known-deletion populations; 1000 independent audit orders each, not independently sampled image datasets.
secondary.timing_scope: Per-method elapsed times are collected under concurrent worker load and are execution diagnostics, not isolated hardware-normalized speed benchmarks. Detector compute is reported separately from measured-image label budgets.

failure_policy: Numerical or integrity errors halt execution and preserve evidence. No seed replacement, new methods, dataset search or extra repetitions. Empty intervals are noncovering and receive full-capacity scored width while their emptiness is separately reported.

implementation_clarifications.coco_geometry: Clip provider boxes to image bounds; require positive clipped area. Target eligibility uses clipped height >=25, non-crowd person category and at most 20 targets per image selected by annotation-ID hash.
implementation_clarifications.matching_reference: All retained positive-area provider person boxes remain matching references, including non-target, short and crowd boxes. Only eligible hash-capped targets are deleted. Retained short/crowd references prevent conflating these out-of-target proposals with the target and are disclosed explicitly.
implementation_clarifications.matching: Maximum cardinality, then maximum total IoU at threshold 0.5; SciPy linear assignment with cardinality bonus greater than the maximum possible total IoU difference.
implementation_clarifications.features: Unmatched detector count, retained eligible-provider count, filtered detector count, three unmatched-height bins; plus full-frame leave-one-out versions of the three counts. All COCO images have one bookkeeping group, not invented drive identities.
implementation_clarifications.folds: One frame_id per fixed COCO deletion scenario, shared by all repetitions; synthetic populations have distinct frame identities.
